stage5Verses:
BURIED BENEATH THE FROZEN WASTE
NO REMEDY FOR THE BITTER TASTE

WE FORGE OUR OATH IN BLACKENED STEEL
THE DEAD STILL WATCH, THE SCARS STILL HEAL

UNDER A SKY OF SHATTERED TEETH
WE PLANT OUR FLAGS IN HOLY WREATHS

THE THRONE IS COLD, THE CROWN IS THORNS
A KING IS CARVED WHERE HOPE WAS BORN

WHEN STARLIGHT DIES IN SILENT DROVES
THE ABYSS LEARNS THE NAMES WE WROTE

ASHEN CHOIRS IN CATHEDRAL FLAME
SING WARLIKE HYMNS WITHOUT A NAME

THE OCEAN OPENS LIKE A WOUND
AND SWALLOWS ARMIES WITHOUT A SOUND

WE HEAR THE ANVIL, FEEL THE SPARK
A SUNSET HAMMERED INTO DARK

RAVENS FEAST ON FALLEN KINGS
WHILE IRON BELLS OF RUIN RING

THE WITCH MOON RISES, VEILED IN BLOOD
WE WALK THE PATH NO SAINT EVER COULD

FROM CRYPT TO CRYPT THE LEGIONS CRAWL
ONE DRUMBEAT SHAKES THE MARBLE HALL

THE COMET CUTS THE HEAVEN THIN
AND POURS ITS POISON DEEP WITHIN

OUR BANNERS WHIP IN SULFUR WIND
WE MARCH WHERE LIGHT HAS NEVER BEEN

EACH PRAYER WE SPOKE TURNED INTO DUST
SO NOW WE TEMPER FAITH WITH RUST

THE MONOLITH HUMS A HUNGERED TONE
IT CALLS OUR BONES BACK TO THE STONE

IN MIDNIGHT ARMOR, CLAW AND SPEAR
WE FEED THE GODS OF ANCIENT FEAR

THE TEMPLE CRACKS, THE IDOLS BLEED
THE EARTH ITSELF BEGINS TO KNEEL

A THOUSAND TORCHES, ONE LAST GATE
WE SMILE LIKE WOLVES AND NAME IT FATE

THE VOID LOOKED BACK THROUGH SERRATED LIGHT
AND STOLE THE COLOR FROM THE NIGHT

WE CARVE OUR VOWS IN DRAGON BONE
NO TYRANT DIES, THEY CHANGE THE THRONE

THROUGH BLIZZARD FANG AND CINDER RAIN
WE LEARN TO BREATHE INSIDE THE PAIN

THE ALTAR TREMBLES, RIVERS BOIL
CROWNS GROW HEAVY FROM THE SOIL

BLACK SUN ABOVE, RED MUD BELOW
WE REAP THE FIELD WHERE WAR-SEEDS GROW

THE BELL OF DOOM STRIKES TWICE AT DAWN
BY DUSK THE CITY SKIN IS GONE

A CHOIR OF BLADES AROUND THE FIRE
SINGS OF CROWNS AND FUNERAL PYRES

WE HUNT THE SKY WITH BROKEN WINGS
AND DRAG DOWN HALOED, LIAR KINGS

IN CATACOMBS OF SALT AND GLASS
THE FUTURE DIES AND STILL WE PASS

THE COSMOS WHISPERS THROUGH OUR VEINS
IN FRACTAL TONGUES AND BARBED REFRAINS

THE MARROW DRUMS BENEATH THE HILL
AN ELDER GOD FORGETS TO SLEEP

WE BIND THE STORM WITH CHAIN AND NAIL
THEN RIDE ITS BACK THROUGH KINGDOMS PALE

ALL SAINTS WERE SILENT WHEN WE FELL
SO WE MADE TORCHES OUT OF HELL

THE BASTION BURNS IN CERULEAN FIRE
WE LAUGH AND FEED THE PYRE HIGHER

THE HARBOR CHOKES ON IRON TIDE
LEVIATHANS TURN IN THEIR SLEEP

WITH EVERY STEP THE GRAVEYARD SINGS
OF BATTLEFIELD AND BROKEN STRINGS

A SHADOW CROWNED IN WINTER FROST
DEMANDS THE NAMES OF ALL WE LOST

THE SKY UNRAVELS, STITCH BY STITCH
REVEALING EYES TOO OLD TO BLINK

WE ETCH THE RUNES IN LIGHTLESS ICE
AND PAY THE STARS THEIR BLOODY PRICE

THE FINAL BANNER KISSES DIRT
YET STILL OUR WARCRY SPLITS THE EARTH

THERE IS NO MERCY IN THE DEEP
ONLY JAWS THAT NEVER SLEEP

THE PALACE FLOOR IS FLOODING RED
WITH ECHOES OF THE UNBURIED DEAD

WE SHARPEN HATE ON TEMPEST STONE
AND MAKE THE THUNDER CALL US HOME

A CANDLE FLICKERS IN THE MAW
OF GODS THAT FEED ON FEAR AND LAW

THE ORBIT BREAKS, THE STARS COLLIDE
WE ROW THROUGH NIGHT ON RIVERS WIDE

OUR HELMS ARE DENTED, SPIRITS RAW
STILL WE ADVANCE WITH TOOTH AND CLAW

THE OLD ONES STIR BENEATH THE SAND
AND WRITE THEIR HUNGER ON THE LAND

NO CHAPEL STANDS, NO ANGEL STAYS
ONLY THE ASH OF FORMER DAYS

WE FOUND A THRONE OF FOSSIL FLAME
AND CROWNED OURSELVES IN ENDLESS RAIN

THE SERPENT WRAPS THE MOON IN COIL
AND MILKS THE NIGHT FOR FEAR AND OIL

EACH BROKEN SPEAR BECOMES A CROSS
TO MARK THE COST OF GLORIOUS LOSS

WHEN EVERYTHING IS DUST AND BRINE
OUR FINAL ROAR OUTLIVES ALL TIME

THE WARDRUM BOWS TO NONE
WE ANSWER STEEL WITH STEEL ALONE

HOLLOW SAINTS SHAKES THE THRONE
THE STARS COLLAPSE BUT WE ENDURE

HOLLOW SAINTS CARVES THE SKY
THE DEAD REMEMBER EVERY STEP
